name: voce-vscode-copilot-extension
description: VOCE-DevOps, a 'Vs-cOde Copilot Extension' supporting referencing of GitHub issues/PRs and Azure DevOps work items/PRs

voce.echoFullIssue.description: echo the full issue title and description in the chat.

voce.echoIssueComments.description: echo the comments of issue chat (only if echoFullIssue is also set).

voce.echoFullWorkItem.description: echo the full work item title and description in the chat.

voce.echoWorkItemComments.description: echo the comments of work item chat (only if echoFullWorkItem is also set).

voce.azureDevOpsPat.description: Personal Access Token for Azure DevOps API access. Required for work item functionality.

chatParticipants.name: voce
chatParticipants.description: VOCE-DevOps: GitHub `!<issueNumber>` or `!<prNumber>` and Azure DevOps `!<workItemNumber>` or `!<prNumber>`, append `+` for including comments.

commands.name: gh-issue
commands.description: get data from GitHub issue using `!<issueNumber>`. Use `gh:<owner>/<repo>` to add a github context.

commands.name: gh-pullrequest
commands.description: get data from GitHub pullrequest. Use `gh:<owner>/<repo>` to add a github context.

commands.name: azd-workitem
commands.description: get data from Azure DevOps work item using `#<workItemNumber>`. Use `azdo:<org>/<project>` to add Azure DevOps context.

commands.name: azd-pullrequest
commands.description: get data from Azure DevOps pullrequest using `!<prNumber>`. Use `azdo:<org>/<project>` to add Azure DevOps context.

scripts.package: npm run vscode:prepublish && vsce package && npm run move-packages-installer-dir
